Name: talkohlooeys-style RRRR Wizard Portraits
Author: calephelis
Description:
The list of RRRR-compatible portraits is still rather small, so I decided to help fix that -- by adapting [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5269?tab=files]talkohlooeys' Young Wizard portraits[/url],  redrawing him to be more in-line with the design used in RRRR and expanding the sheet to a full 32 expressions.

In addition, I have plans to eventually:

[list]
[*]Adapt the seasonal outfits in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17284/]Jello's Vanilla-ish RRRR Wizard[/url].
[/list][list]
[*]...And also the added hairstyle options, probably. Maybe.
[*]Make a talkoh-style portrait for NPC Jello.
[*]Expand the matching Caroline and Pierre portraits.
[/list]

Requires either [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10971]HD Portraits[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url].
